description:
A Celebration of Global Friendship

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown and Brooklyn Bridge Rotary Club in New york

2 Rotarians from Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, India, had the privilege of connecting with fellow Rotarians New york

One of the most memorable moments of the exchange was the Flag Exchange Ceremony at The Watermark 21 Clarke Street New york . The ceremony was hosted in the warm company of Brooklyn Bridge Rotary Club in New york

The exchange of flags beautifully represented the spirit of Rotary—friendship, fellowship, cultural understanding and international goodwill. Two Rotary flags, two countries and two cultures came together to create a bond that goes far beyond geographical boundaries.

The warm welcome extended by our New york Rotary friends made the occasion truly special. The gathering was filled with camaraderie, meaningful conversations and the shared joy of being part of the worldwide Rotary family.

From Mumbai to New york – Flags Exchanged, Friendships Strengthened, Hearts Connected.

2026–27 strengthening the beautiful bond between Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown and Brooklyn Bridge Rotary Club New York

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
